Container.Name: hubspot-beta-tracker
Container.Overview: Tracks HubSpot product updates, betas, rollouts, and sunsets. Persistent tracker state and portal authentication live under Unraid appdata.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Local tracker HTTP port; Cloudflare Tunnel routes the public hostname.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Tracker state, scan history, browser-auth file, subscriber list, and local stats.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Persistent data directory inside the container.

Config.Name: Portal auth file
Config.Description: Persistent Chrome-extension refresh target; do not put cookie values in this template.

Config.Name: Admin API key
Config.Description: Existing key accepted from the Chrome refresh extension. Keep this value masked.

Config.Name: Scan API key
Config.Description: Existing key protecting the manual scan endpoint. Keep this value masked.

Config.Name: Discord alert webhook
Config.Description: Optional existing alert destination. Keep this value masked.

Config.Name: HubSpot access token
Config.Description: Optional existing subscriber-sync credential. Keep this value masked.

Config.Name: Portal stale threshold hours
Config.Description: Health endpoint returns unhealthy when the newest authenticated portal item is older than this threshold.

Config.Name: Portal alert cooldown hours
Config.Description: Minimum time between portal-auth failure alerts.
